findings.title: Ingress serves a host that its TLS does not cover
findings.cause: Ingress web has TLS for www.shop.example.com, but its rules also serve shop.example.com, which no TLS entry covers, so HTTPS requests to shop.example.com get the controller's default certificate, which clients reject

evidence.what: the Ingress's rule hosts and TLS hosts

findings.fix: Add shop.example.com to the hosts of a tls entry whose Secret's certificate covers it (or correct the rule's host if it is a typo).
